Git.Worktree.Tip.Broken:
Broken git worktree remnant
Its .git link is dangling — the linked repository is gone.
Use Remove to delete the leftover folder.
Git.Worktree.Remove.Title: Remove worktree?
Git.Worktree.Remove.BrokenPromptFormat:
Remove broken worktree remnant '{0}'?

Its .git link is dangling — the linked repository is gone, so this can't be opened as a worktree. Removing deletes the leftover folder. This cannot be undone.
Git.Worktree.Remove.NoMergeTargetFormat: • Branch '{0}' has no known merge target.
Git.Worktree.Remove.NeverPushed: • The branch has never been pushed — its commits exist only here.
Git.Worktree.Remove.CommitsLostFormat: • {0} commit(s) are not on the remote and will be lost.
Git.Worktree.Remove.DeletesFolder: This deletes the folder. This cannot be undone.
Git.Worktree.Remove.DeletesFolderAndBran: This deletes the folder and the branch '{0}'. This cannot be undone.
Git.Worktree.Removal.NotWorktree: This folder is not a git worktree.
Git.Worktree.Removal.InUseFormat: Couldn't remove the worktree — a file inside it is still in use. Close anything open under it (and don't run the app from the worktree you're deleting), then try again. ({0})
Git.Worktree.Removal.RemovedPartialForma: Removed worktree '{0}', but some git cleanup failed: {1}.
Git.Worktree.Removal.RemovedWithBranchPa: Removed worktree '{0}' and branch '{1}', but some git cleanup failed: {2}.
